title: feat(components,plugin-list): a list block in a narrow page region draws a compact list (objectui#12703)
body:
Part of #12703
Clause-②: yes — `@object-ui/components` exports a new hook `usePageRegionPosture` and type `PageRegionPosture`, and `@object-ui/plugin-list`'s `ListViewProps` gains the optional host prop `compact` (the dispatch's provisional `no`, corrected by measurement).

## What this does

A `list-view` block in a page region narrower than half the page now draws a compact list: a header with its title and record count over two-line rows (the view's first visible column, its second muted below). It draws no toolbar, no view tabs, no `#` row-number column, no pager and no record-count bar. A region half the page or wider keeps today's full list, and so does any region whose width is not known.

**`Part of`, not a closing keyword:** the ruled "View all" footer link is NOT in this PR. Opening the object list needs a destination the renderer cannot build on its own; the report on the card asks the PM to choose the mechanism. That half stays open.

## How the posture is decided (A1, measured)

A1 as stated is false: a page region does not know its width or span at render. Regions are placed by CSS (`aside` is `md:w-80` next to a `flex-1` main), and the 12-column grid from objectui#12624 spans BLOCKS inside a region, not regions. So the page renderer now measures:

- `PageRenderer` watches its max-width body element (the element its regions are laid out in), and each `RegionContent` watches its own grid, both through `ResizeObserver` with a first `getBoundingClientRect` reading in a layout effect. Nothing reads the window.
- `pageRegionPostureFor(region, page)` returns `compact` when the region is narrower than `(page - 24) / 2`, which is half the page less the `gap-6` between side-by-side regions. A half-and-half cell (the `dashboard` template) therefore stays `full`.
- The answer reaches blocks through `usePageRegionPosture()` (new export of `@object-ui/components`). It is `null` outside a page region, before a measurement, without `ResizeObserver`, and on the server. `null` means full.
- The page width is a subscription store, not a context value, so a resize re-renders a region only when its posture flips.
- No spec key is added or read. The posture is width-driven only.

`ListViewBlock` (the `list-view` registration) reads the posture and passes the new `compact` host prop to `ListView`. `ListView` is unchanged for every other host, so the object list page is untouched. The compact posture applies to a paged grid, the view whose rows `ListView` fetches a page of. A board, a calendar or a grouped grid keeps its own rendering. Rows render values through the shared cell renderers (`getCellRenderer`), and a row click goes through the same `navigation.handleClick` a grid row uses.

Studio: the non-design page preview renders through `SchemaRenderer` and `PageRenderer`, so it shows the posture with no change. The design-mode canvas (`PageBlockCanvas`) draws block cards, not the page renderer, and per the ruling no second designer rendering was built. `PagePreview.tsx` is untouched.

## Files

- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page-region-posture.tsx` (new): the rule, the page width store, the region provider, the hook.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`, `page-block-grid.tsx` (a `gridRef` prop), `packages/components/src/index.ts` (the export).
- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListViewBlock.tsx`, `ListView.tsx` (the `compact` prop and its branches), `ListViewCompact.tsx` (new: header and rows).
- Tests beside each package, and `.changeset/12703-compact-list-block.md`.

## Evidence (all at `f61f6f2e7`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListViewBlock.compactRegion-12703.test.tsx`: 6 passed. This pins (a) the aside block (320 of 1200) with no toolbar trigger, no tablist, no grid (so no `#` column), no count bar, and two two-line rows (first column over second); (b) its header title and count; (c) CONTROL: the main block (856 of 1200) on the same page with toolbar and grid, `showRowNumbers: true`, and exactly one grid on the page; unknown width keeps the full list; (d) CONTROL: the object list page `ListView` and the block with no page are both full.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-region-posture-12703.test.tsx`: 8 passed (the rule's thresholds, aside compact and main full, stacked aside full, a block nested in a `page:card` reads the region, no `ResizeObserver` gives unknown, no regions gives none, no page gives none).
- Ablation: `pageRegionPostureFor` mutated to always return `full` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `761c974f5b56` to `0dc11caf582a`). Pin (a) went RED, and so did control (c), because with both blocks full the page holds two grids instead of one. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Reverse type check on the rebuilt declarations: comparing `usePageRegionPosture()` with `'narrow'` in `ListViewBlock.tsx` gives `TS2367 ... types 'PageRegionPosture | null' and '"narrow"' have no overlap`. Restored, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' build`, then `type-check` for `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-list`: exit 0, both script names echoed.
- Whole `packages/plugin-list/` dir: 144 files, 1493 tests passed.
- `packages/components`, narrowed and declared: the 22 test files that render the page renderer (selected by `git grep` for regions, PageRenderer, the block grid or a page type) passed, 224 tests. The other component tests are declared to CI.
- `packages/app-shell` tests that name PageView, PagePreview or `data-region`: 41 files, 350 tests passed.
- `eslint` on the 9 changed ts/tsx files, run as the package `lint` scripts run it (`eslint .`, no `--max-warnings`): 0 errors. There is no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` in `eslint.config.js`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- Gates, exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations`, plus `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check-changeset-presence`. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with `no-artifact` for unbuilt packages, which is expected on main; recorded, not fixed.

## Acceptance notes

- Screenshots of Sales Home at 1024 and 1280 px are the maintainer's browser check and are not attached. Reading of HotCRM `main` (`4f82b81`): the Sales Home page has `header`, `main` and an `aside` of width `medium`. At 1024 px with the app sidebar open, the page body is about 736 px wide and the aside is 320 px, so the aside is compact and `main` (about 392 px, above 356) stays full.
- HotCRM's embedded `list-view` nodes still write `properties.objectName` and `viewType`, which objectui `main` no longer reads (objectui#12099; the platform converts stored nodes). No compact-specific change follows from that here.
- The compact title is the node's `label` and falls back to the object label. In Sales Home the block's `page:card` also has a title ("Upcoming Events"), so the card title and the list title both appear. That follows the ruling ("the block header shows its title"); the card can drop one of the two.
- Rows show the window the list fetched (the grid's page size). No new cap was added. An author caps rows with `pagination.pageSize`.
- AGENTS.md #2 docs: `packages/plugin-list/README.md` (the `compact` host prop), `packages/components/README.md` (`usePageRegionPosture()`, null means full, the `(page - 24) / 2` cut) and `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md` (a `list-view` in a narrow region renders the compact list, measured and not authored, with "View all" as a follow-up) are updated in `f04480a34`, per the revised claim.
